description: This file defines an interface and a concrete implementation for a project repository, managing CRUD and stream operations for Project entities stored in Firestore within a Flutter app.

classes.name: IProjectRepository
classes.description: Abstract interface defining the contract for project data operations, including streaming, fetching by ID, upserting, and deleting projects.

classes.name: ProjectRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of IProjectRepository that interacts with Firestore to perform CRUD operations and stream project data, managing user IDs and Firestore paths.

methods.name: streamProjects
methods.description: Streams a list of projects for a given user, ordered by 'sortOrder'.

methods.name: streamProject
methods.description: Streams a single project identified by ID for a given user.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a project by its ID for a given user.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a project in Firestore, returning the project ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a project by ID for a given user.

methods.name: _requireUid
methods.description: Ensures a valid user ID is available, either from parameter or provider, throwing an error if not.
